title: fix(plugin-security, core)!: a transfer is explained and hinted only where the record can be edited and its owner changed
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `security.explain` with `operation: 'transfer'` and the `allowTransfer` bit of the `objects` map `/me/permissions` serves now answer edit and the transfer grant together, at the object and the record level, on every object.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skills state the transfer grant as enforcement reads it, which is unchanged; they teach neither explain's `transfer` nor the `/me/permissions` hint.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`security.explain` 的 `transfer` 只在「可编辑 且 持有转移授权」时才报可转移(对象级和记录级);`/me/permissions` 下发的 `allowTransfer` 对所有对象同样只在可编辑时为 true。
- 为什么改:转移就是改记录的 owner,即一次更新;解释与客户端提示要和这扇门给同一个答案(裁决记录 6755714726,ADR-0142 同 PR 修订)。
- 风险与回滚:执行层不变(评估器与 owner 闸门未动,新建并指派他人只需转移授权);服务端求值的 `current_user.can()` 不变,Console 端求值的谓词读下发的提示,对「有转移授权无编辑」者答 false(只会少显示,服务端照常裁决)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`(`servedObjectPermissions` / `clampTransferToEdit`)、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts`(`objectGrantOf`)、`docs/adr/0142-*.md` 的修订注。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts`,预期全绿,含「a transfer grant without edit: can() evaluated on the server keeps it, the served hint does not」。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 触及 `docs/adr/**`(Tier H),需你审批并合入。

## What changes

The rule (ruling of record 6755714726 on #32004): a transfer is reported only where the record could be edited and its owner changed — edit (which implies read) and the transfer grant. The ruling's carriers are explain, the client permission hint and ADR-0142's mapping text; enforcement and the server-evaluated expression predicate are unchanged. A predicate the Console evaluates reads the served hint, so for a principal holding the transfer grant without edit a client-evaluated `current_user.can(object, 'transfer')` answers `false`.

- `@objectstack/plugin-security` — explain's `object_crud` layer composes the two halves for `transfer` (`objectGrantOf`). Both halves are asked of the same set list the door asks them of, so edit from one set and the transfer grant from another compose, and both sets are named. The record-grained verdict follows the layer. The evaluator's `transfer` cell and the ownership gate are unchanged.
- `@objectstack/core` — `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` is unchanged. It is computed once and is the map `current_user.can()` reads on the server. A new export, `servedObjectPermissions`, derives the served slot from it: a fresh copy with one clamp, `clampTransferToEdit`, applied (`allowTransfer` follows edit on every entry, the `*` entry included). The module docblock records the split and the ruling's carrier list.
- `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` — `/auth/me/permissions` serves `servedObjectPermissions(buildEffectiveObjectPermissions(…))`.
- `@objectstack/spec` — the `getEffectiveObjectPermissions` contract docblock and the `GetEffectivePermissionsResponseSchema.objects` description name the one bit the served slot derives; `content/docs/references/api/auth.mdx` is regenerated by `gen:docs`.
- `docs/adr/0142-*.md` — the mapping sentence in Context §1 is anchored to `explain-engine.ts#objectGrantOf` and `effective-object-permissions.ts#clampTransferToEdit`. A dated amendment note and a Status-line entry cite the ruling and state that enforcement and server-evaluated `current_user.can()` are unchanged, and that a Console-evaluated predicate reads the hint. D4 states that a claim is reported by its own reason.
- `content/docs/permissions/explain.mdx` — one paragraph states that `transfer` is a conjunction, and that the served hint gives the same answer.
- Changeset: patch on the four packages, with a BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition `no-migration-prescription`. Its migration text names the consequence for an author who gated an assign-on-create offer on `current_user.can(object, 'transfer')`: the Console withholds it from a principal holding the transfer grant without edit, while the server admits the insert.

## Tests

- `explain-engine.test.ts` — new top-level describe. It covers four principals, each at the object and the record level: the transfer grant alone, edit alone, edit and the transfer grant, read and the transfer grant. It also pins the missing half by name, two-set composition and its attribution, and CONTROL pins for `modifyAllRecords` and for the evaluator's `transfer` cell, which stays the transfer grant alone.
- `explain-enforce-parity.test.ts` — door level. For the same four principals, explain's object-level `allowed` and record-level `visible` equal the owner-change door's answer, and each principal's door answer is pinned (CONTROL). A second CONTROL pins that an insert naming another owner is admitted by the transfer grant without edit, and refused without the grant.
- `effective-object-permissions.test.ts` (core) — the same four shapes on a guarded managed object that opts edit in and on an ordinary object: the served slot is narrowed and the base map keeps the grant as granted. Also pinned: two-set composition; the `*` entry; the served slot differs from the base map in that one bit alone and never mutates it; no key added to an entry carrying none; `modifyAllRecords` keeps transfer.
- `get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts` — the `can()` versus evaluator parity battery is as on `main`. New pin: a principal holding the transfer grant without edit gets `current_user.can(object, 'transfer') === true` in a server-evaluated expression, while the served slot carries `allowTransfer: false`; with a CONTROL for edit and the transfer grant.
- `current-user-endpoints-effective-objects.test.ts` (plugin-hono-server) — the real endpoint serves `allowTransfer: false` for that principal, byte-equal to `servedObjectPermissions` of the base map, while the base map keeps `true`; with a CONTROL.

## Acceptance notes

- What the `ui/` consumers of the hint show today:
  - The owner-field write check in `MePermissionsProvider.checkField` already asks edit after the transfer grant, so its answer does not move. The affordance resolver and `RecordFieldAccessScope` reach it through that check.
  - The form's create-for-another-owner path does not read the hint.
  - The queue Claim button reads explain's `queue_claim` attribution only, which this change does not touch.
  - The Access explain panel shows explain's composed answer.
  - Client-side `current_user.can()`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` binds the served `objects` map through `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/subjectPermissions.ts` as the answer sheet for predicates the Console evaluates, so there `can(object, 'transfer')` follows the hint and answers `false` for a principal holding the transfer grant without edit. The client under-offers; the server decides.
  - No UI code changed.
- `current_user.can(object, 'transfer')` evaluated on the server (option `visibleWhen`, CEL `defaultValue`, `formula`) reads the base map and keeps the transfer grant; pinned. Evaluated in the Console, it reads the served hint (above).
- Docs that grant `allowTransfer` beside read and edit (`permission-metadata.mdx`, `docs/design/permission-model.md`) stay true. No other sentence in `content/docs/**` about explain's `transfer` or the hint disagreed.

## Verification
